name: TOP_glitch
description: RGB split, block shift, scanline tears, streaks, compression hold

name: TOP_vhs_crt
description: VHS/CRT emulation: wobble, chroma bleed, tracking noise, mask, curvature

name: TOP_feedback_trails
description: Feedback trails with transform, hue drift and displacement

name: TOP_filmic_look
description: Bloom, glare, chromatic aberration, ACES tonemap, grain, vignette

name: TOP_halftone
description: Halftone (CMYK/mono), Bayer/error-diffusion dither and ASCII

name: TOP_toon_outline
description: Posterize with ink or neon edge lines

name: TOP_slit_scan
description: Slit-scan time displacement from a frame ring buffer

name: TOP_optical_flow
description: GPU optical flow driving smear, warp or flow visualization

name: TOP_kaleidoscope
description: Radial, tiled and hyperbolic kaleidoscope

name: TOP_droste_zoom
description: Log-polar Droste infinite zoom

name: TOP_dof_motionblur
description: Depth of field (depth/luma/radial) and motion blur

name: TOP_false_color
description: Thermal / x-ray / night-vision false colour with HUD

name: TOP_pixel_sort
description: True GPU pixel sort, bytebeat bands, channel shuffle

name: TOP_pixel_stretch
description: Directional pixel-drag smear from a luminance threshold

name: TOP_glass_refraction
description: Moving glass shape refracting the input with dispersion

name: TOP_tracker_hud
description: Tracking HUD: feature boxes, ID/coordinate labels, links, grid

name: TOP_type_overlay
description: Monospace title card, telemetry read-outs and crop marks

name: TOP_instance_grid
description: Image to a 3D field of instanced boxes, spheres or cones

name: POP_mesh_deformer
description: Twist, bend, inflate, noise and ripple deformer stack

name: POP_plexus_points
description: Scan-strata point cloud with plexus lines and grid

name: POP_pointcloud_dissolve
description: Mesh to points that erode into curl-noise dust and re-form

name: POP_particle_emitter
description: Emit GPU particles from the input geometry (points/surface) with curl noise, gravity, attractors

name: TOP_reaction_diffusion
description: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion grown from / fed by the input image; outputs the chemical field

name: TOP_fluid
description: 2D stable fluid that advects and smears the input image as dye (inject or seed), with an optional velocity/force TOP; outputs smeared image, velocity and dye fields. Feed a Text TOP for fluid text.

name: POP_boids
description: Flock the input points (boids); outputs the moving points and an instanced cone mesh

name: TOP_physarum
description: Slime-mold agents that follow the input image brightness; outputs the trail map

name: TOP_cellular_automata
description: Cellular automaton driven by an image: bright pixels seed (and keep injecting) cells; cells take the input colours. Life, Brians Brain, Wireworld, Larger than Life, custom B/S. out2 = raw state.

name: POP_cloth
description: Verlet cloth simulation of the input mesh, pinned by group/attribute, wind, sphere collider

name: POP_attractor_advect
description: Advect the input points along a strange-attractor field (Lorenz, Aizawa, Thomas, Halvorsen, Dadras), optionally with trails

name: GEN_lsystem
description: L-system branching growth with presets

name: TOP_voronoi
description: Voronoi cells / cracked & stained glass coloured by sampling the input image at each cell site; density can follow luminance or edges. out2 = cell id colour with edge distance in alpha

name: TOP_flow_field_lines
description: Long-exposure strokes advected along a field derived from the input image (edge contours, gradient, luminance or hue angle), coloured by the image. out2 = the field (direction in RG, strength in B).

name: POP_terrain
description: Displace the input grid by a heightmap TOP: scrolling retro terrain geometry

name: POP_tentacles
description: Grow writhing tubes from the input points

name: TOP_video_synth
description: LZX/Hydra-style oscillators that modulate, displace and colorise the input image

name: GEN_kinetic_type
description: Per-glyph 3D kinetic typography

name: TOP_glyphs
description: Glyph / ASCII rendering of the input image (grid, rain, tunnel layouts)

name: MAT_iridescent
description: Thin-film iridescence, fresnel rainbow, anisotropic sheen

name: MAT_jelly
description: Gummy fake-subsurface material with rim glow

name: MAT_wet_black
description: Wet black oil/tar clearcoat with drips

name: MAT_brushed_metal
description: Anisotropic brushed and anodized metal

name: MAT_crystal
description: Faceted crystal refraction with dispersion

name: MAT_ferrofluid
description: Ferrofluid spikes pulled by an attractor

name: MAT_porcelain
description: Porcelain, marble or bone with veins and cracks

name: MAT_velvet
description: Velvet sheen or shell fur

name: MAT_molten
description: Emissive molten cracks in cooling crust

name: MAT_decay
description: Rust and corrosion weathering

name: MAT_hologram_scan
description: Hologram wire lattice with scan sweep and dropout

name: MAT_matcap
description: Procedural matcap library with switcher

name: MAT_triplanar
description: UV-less triplanar procedural texturing

name: MAT_screen_stylize
description: Per-object dither, halftone or ASCII shading

name: UTIL_auto_arrange
description: Arrange a network: left-to-right flow, no overlapping nodes (td_organize)

name: TOP_depth_fog
description: Depth fog and horizon glow from a depth map (any Render TOP / SDF_render depth)

name: TOP_ssao
description: Screen-space ambient occlusion from depth + normals

name: TOP_env_reflect
description: Environment reflection (chrome / glass look) from normals and an env map

name: TOP_normal_shade
description: Shade a normal map with a matcap or key/rim lights

name: SDF_box
description: SDF primitive: rounded box (size, roundness, colour).

name: SDF_combine
description: SDF operation: union, subtract, intersect or morph two SDFs with smooth blending.

name: SDF_deform
description: SDF operation: twist, bend, noise-displace, round or hollow out (onion) an SDF.

name: SDF_fractal
description: SDF primitive: Mandelbulb, Menger sponge or kaleidoscopic IFS fractal distance estimator.

name: SDF_gyroid
description: SDF primitive: gyroid / Schwarz-P / diamond triply periodic minimal surface, optionally bounded by a sphere.

name: SDF_plane
description: SDF primitive: infinite plane with optional checker.

name: SDF_render
description: SDF renderer: raymarches an SDF wire into color, linear depth, view normals and world position, using a Camera COMP.

name: SDF_repeat
description: SDF operation: repeat an SDF on an infinite or finite grid, or around an axis (polar).

name: SDF_sphere
description: SDF primitive: sphere (radius, colour). Wire its SDF output into other SDF_ nodes.

name: SDF_to_MAT
description: SDF converter (lossy): a GLSL MAT that raymarches an SDF wire inside proxy box geometry and writes depth, so it composites with Render TOP scenes. Use Apply To like the MAT_ components.

name: SDF_to_POP
description: SDF converter (lossy): polygonize an SDF wire into a mesh POP over chosen bounds and resolution (marching cubes).

name: SDF_to_TOP
description: SDF converter (lossy): bake an SDF wire into a 3D texture TOP (R = distance, GBA = color) over chosen bounds and resolution.

name: SDF_torus
description: SDF primitive: torus (major/minor radius, axis, colour).

name: SDF_transform
description: SDF operation: translate, rotate and uniformly scale an SDF.

name: SDF_from_POP
description: SDF primitive from POP geometry: points become smooth-unioned metaballs (live, GPU grid), or a closed mesh is baked into a distance volume (lossy). Wire its SDF output into other SDF_ nodes.
